description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing and caching user and session data within a React application. It includes hooks for consuming the context and handles initial data loading, error states, and refresh functions.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Hook to access the shared DataContext providing user and session data.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: React component that initializes and provides cached user and session data, along with refresh functions, to its children.
